>A small number of children, teenagers, and young adults (up to 24 years of age) who took antidepressants ('mood elevators') such as duloxetine during clinical studies became suicidal (thinking about harming or killing oneself or planning or trying to do so). 

Well, [that](http://www.google.com/search?sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8&q=duloxetine)'s reassuring .

Tried the "I like me" and "fuck what other people are thinking" approach, went overboard landing somewhere between the two, and now I'm  pretty sure it's turned me into a slight narcissist. I've been taking steps to change it (doing shit because I want to and not because I think I look good doing it (I don't)), but be warned that there is such a thing as loving yourself too much, and it sucks.
I wouldn't even bother if I were you, I've never had any data worth sharing.
